# Apartment Floor Plans | The Standard at Seattle

We want to make understanding your housing costs as simple and transparent as possible. _The prices shown on this page reflect a monthly installment based on our standard **11.5-month (50-week) lease term**. Your total housing cost is divided into **12 equal monthly payments,** each due on the 1st of the month, and includes the base price plus all mandatory fees and any premiums or add-ons._ Each floor plan may be displayed as a range - from the minimum inclusive rate (base rent plus all mandatory fees) to the maximum inclusive rate (with all available unit premiums).

For a more detailed, personalized estimate, we recommend using the **Price Calculator** linked above. It's the best way to confidently choose the floor plan that fits both your lifestyle and your budget.

# How To Assign Your Housing Contract

### Getting Started

Follow these simple steps to begin the process of assigning your housing contract to another person.

1.  **Locate a potential candidate.** You will be responsible to locate the individual whom you would like to take over your contract.
2.  **Fully complete an Assignment Intent Form.** The current resident must acknowledge and sign the form.
3.  **Have the incoming resident apply.** The individual who is taking over your contract must apply and be approved before your assignment is completed.
    *   To avoid any confusion or potential issues, only make payments for rent, fees, or deposits directly to the Landlord’s management office. Do not engage in any financial transactions or pass-through of funds with the incoming resident (Assignment). This ensures that all financial matters are handled officially and transparently through the appropriate channels.
4.  **Pay the assignment fee.** Applicable assignment fee in Housing Contract must be paid with submission of the Assignment Intent Form.

### Verification

Once the incoming resident is approved in our system, the following steps will need to be verified before we can facilitate your assignment:

1.  **You must have a current balance of $0.**
2.  **All forms and fees are submitted and paid.**
3.  **Keys must be turned in no later than the day before the new tenant’s scheduled move-in date.** Please note that all reassignments are accepted **as-is**, based on the current condition of the unit at the time the keys are returned. We only allow move-ins on the **1st of each month;** the latest lease start date for a reassignment can be no later**June 1st**. No exceptions are made to move-out or move-in dates.
4.  **New resident must pick up keys.** This will finalize the assignment process.

* * *

### New Tenant

Prior to the incoming resident moving in, they will need the following items verified before we can issue keys:

1.  **All fees paid,** including first monthly installment.
2.  **Move-in items complete.** Utility account transferred to new tenant, verified proof of insurance submitted if opting out of Landmark Liability Insurance, and must complete Pet Screening profile.
3.  **Acknowledge the 48-hour window** before picking up keys.

**_Please Note: Due to assignments, we will send Wi-Fi credentials upon move-in._**

## Housing Contract Assignment FAQs

By assigning your contract, you are releasing all obligations of the contract to an approved applicant to resume said obligations through the duration of the contract.  When you Sub-lease the subtenant must pay rent and comply with the lease terms, but the principal tenant remains ultimately responsible for the lease. This property does not allow subleasing and reserves the right to remove any one person not legally covered under an executed contract.

Once you have completed the process to assign your bedroom, an inspection of your unit will follow your move-out and retrieval of your keys. We will assess the current condition of your bedroom prior to anyone moving in and charge accordingly. The incoming resident will have 48 hours upon moving in to submit their own move-in inspection report to notate condition of bedroom/unit, upon their arrival. Any condition items not notated on their move-in inspection will then be the responsibility of the new resident.

The office does not facilitate advertising available assignments nor finds potential applicants; however, several residents find success searching through various social media groups.

If you cannot successfully find someone to assign your contract, we will remove the fee from your account and credit the amount paid onto your current account balance.

Yes, please contact the office for specific information and directions on this process.

# Schedule A Tour | The Standard at Seattle

## SELF-GUIDED TOUR

### Tour In Person At Your Own Pace

Are you constantly on the go with school, work, social events, or other engagements? Don’t have time to schedule a property tour during office hours? Try our self-guided tour option! You can tour the community at your own pace to see all of the amenities we have to offer without having to set up an appointment with a leasing agent. All you need is your phone!

Click below to learn more about setting up a self-guided tour!

[Register for Tour](https://tours.eliseai.com/?building=43544366-ec42-11ed-9d8e-eb417b952e71&aigt=1)

![Furnished apartment bedroom](https://www.thestandardseattle.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/tour-00002.jpg)

## Guided Tour

### Tour In Person With A Leasing Agent

Our knowledgeable and personable staff would love the opportunity to show you around our **apartments in Seattle**. There is a lot to see and our staff member can provide you with a complete tour of each floor plan and our resident-exclusive amenities. The guided tour is an excellent chance to ask us questions and learn more about our community and the area. For your convenience, we can begin your application process immediately following your guided tour.

Contact us to schedule a date and time for your guided tour with a leasing agent!

[Schedule A Tour](https://www.thestandardseattle.com/contact/)

![Furnished apartment bedroom](https://www.thestandardseattle.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/tour-00005.jpg)

## Live Video Tour

### Get A Live Walkthrough Of Our Community

If you live long-distance or do not have time to make it for a guided tour appointment, we offer live virtual tours with a leasing agent. An experienced staff member will take you around the property and your interested floor plan via live video chat. We always aim to accommodate our residents and this is one of the ways we do so!

Contact us today to schedule a date and time for your live video tour!

[Schedule A Tour](https://www.thestandardseattle.com/contact/)

![Apartment kitchen](https://www.thestandardseattle.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/tour-00004.jpg)

## Virtual Tour

### A Virtual Look At Our Property

If you don’t have time for a tour in person or through video chat, you can still roam around our property virtually. Start in the clubhouse and look around the entire property to see firsthand all of the amenities available in our community. You can even see a sample floor plan to get a feel for our apartments. There’s no registration, and you can move through the tour as fast or as slow as you like and can repeat it at a later time.

Click below to start your virtual tour!

[Take A Virtual Tour](https://www.thestandardseattle.com/virtual-tour/)

### Getting Started

Follow these simple steps to begin the process of assigning your housing contract to another person.

1.  **Locate a potential candidate.** You will be responsible to locate the individual whom you would like to take over your contract.
2.  **Fully complete an Assignment Intent Form.** The current resident must acknowledge and sign the form.
3.  **Have the incoming resident apply.** The individual who is taking over your contract must apply and be approved before your assignment is completed.
    *   To avoid any confusion or potential issues, only make payments for rent, fees, or deposits directly to the Landlord’s management office. Do not engage in any financial transactions or pass-through of funds with the incoming resident (Assignment). This ensures that all financial matters are handled officially and transparently through the appropriate channels.
4.  **Pay the assignment fee.** Applicable assignment fee in Housing Contract must be paid with submission of the Assignment Intent Form.

### Verification

Once the incoming resident is approved in our system, the following steps will need to be verified before we can facilitate your assignment:

1.  **You must have a current balance of $0.**
2.  **All forms and fees are submitted and paid.**
3.  **Keys must be turned in no later than the day before the new tenant’s scheduled move-in date.** Please note that all reassignments are accepted **as-is**, based on the current condition of the unit at the time the keys are returned. We only allow move-ins on the **1st of each month;** the latest lease start date for a reassignment can be no later**June 1st**. No exceptions are made to move-out or move-in dates.
4.  **New resident must pick up keys.** This will finalize the assignment process.

1.  **All fees paid,** including first monthly installment.
2.  **Move-in items complete.** Utility account transferred to new tenant, verified proof of insurance submitted if opting out of Landmark Liability Insurance, and must complete Pet Screening profile.
3.  **Acknowledge the 48-hour window** before picking up keys.

**_Please Note: Due to assignments, we will send Wi-Fi credentials upon move-in._**

Any condition items not notated on their move-in inspection will then be the responsibility of the new resident.

The office does not facilitate advertising available assignments nor finds potential applicants; however, several residents find success searching through various social media groups.
